properties.description: The commands, in titled groups; a group with the id "suggestions" gets ⌘1–⌘5

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Placeholder text in the search field

properties.name: onRun
properties.description: Runs a command (see CommandMenuRun); may return a promise

properties.name: hotkey
properties.description:
Window shortcut that focuses the field: "mod+k" (⌘K on Apple devices, Ctrl K elsewhere), any other combination
like "ctrl+shift+p", or false for none. The most recently connected menu takes it

properties.name: autoFocus
properties.description: Focus the field when the menu appears

properties.name: maxRows
properties.description: Most rows rendered at once – with more matches the menu shows the first ones and asks to keep typing

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-query-change
events.description: The search text changes; detail `{ query }`. Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the current text (controlled use)

events.name: tc-close
events.description: Esc in an empty search; detail: null

functions.name: defaultCommandGroups

changelog: Server-side rendering no longer crashes: `command-menu` builds its icons on first use instead of when the module loads. `check:angular` now imports every dist module in Node with no DOM.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :has()
features.why: Layout and state that depend on what's inside a part (an icon present, a focused field).

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: scrollbar-width
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default width.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
